flags.possible_transcript: action share of dialogue+action words < 0.15 OR scene tags < 20
flags.pretokenised: 20 or more split contractions joined in the dialogue+action layer

text.empty_scene_rule: drop from that layer's timeline; counted

contextual.chunking: a sentence longer than 510 word pieces is cut into consecutive 510-piece chunks, scored, and averaged (counted)
contextual.name: distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english

disagreements.rule: sentences where VADER and sst2 have opposite non-zero signs, 3 to 15 words, drawn at random with `seed`
disagreements.storage: private only; shown in the notebook with output cleared, never on the site

labels.roberta3: argmax of the three classes (negative / neutral / positive)
labels.sst2: sign of P(pos) - P(neg); the model has no neutral class, so it is compared on VADER-non-neutral sentences only

statistics: % sign agreement on sentences VADER calls non-neutral (all three instruments)
Cohen's kappa on three classes, VADER vs roberta3
Spearman correlation of raw scores at sentence, scene (mean, 'both' layer) and film (mean of scene means) level

contextual.chunking: a sentence longer than 510 word pieces is cut into consecutive 510-piece chunks, scored, and averaged (counted)
contextual.name: distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english

robustness_extra.hardware: DTU HPC GPU queue; the runtime projection for the fallback rule is measured on that GPU

modernbert3.caveat: no published English-only or screenplay accuracy; its 'neutral' may mean 'mixed review'. Untested until Step 4 is filled
modernbert3.name: clapAI/modernBERT-large-multilingual-sentiment
modernbert3.role: Step 9 rows and an instrument-agreement row only; never primary, never changes the fallback rule
modernbert3.why: trained mainly on product/movie/hotel reviews: a third domain next to SST-2 and tweets

roberta3.name: cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest
roberta3.why: SST-2 has no neutral class, so it forces neutral action lines to a sign

scene_context.score: mean over pieces weighted by their length in word pieces
scene_context.unit: each scene's 'both' text in order, packed at sentence boundaries into pieces of <= 510 word pieces
scene_context.why: the model sees context instead of isolated sentences (week 7: chunking and the input limit)

draw.allocation: proportional to each genre bin's share of those scenes, largest remainder, at least 1 per bin; uniform within bin; `seed`
draw.blind: raters label from the private preview, which shows the scene text but no instrument score
draw.scenes_from: primary 834, scenes on the timeline (>= 1 dialogue or action sentence)
draw.scripts_from: all 1,087 scripts after Step 1's exclusions, uniform, `seed`

scoring.accuracy: share of scenes where the instrument's label equals the reference label; reported on all resolved scenes (a 'mixed' reference always counts as a miss) and on resolved non-mixed scenes
scoring.error_table: count of each error category, overall and among scenes the primary instrument got wrong
scoring.instrument_label: scene score -> positive / negative / neutral with the same band for every instrument: |score| < 0.05 -> neutral
scoring.rater_agreement: Cohen's kappa on the four labels over scenes both raters labelled
scoring.reference_label: adjudicated label if filled; else rater 1 if rater 2 is empty or agrees; else the scene is counted as unresolved and left out of accuracy

exploratory.min_position: position (0-1) of the minimum of the smoothed arc
exploratory.sign_changes: number of sign changes of (smoothed arc - its own mean)

primary.D2_ending_minus_start: mean of the last 20% minus mean of the first 20% of the RESAMPLED (unsmoothed) arc

arc.split_half: odd vs even non-empty scenes, each resampled and described separately; Spearman-Brown corrected
